messages:
Iris (People Ops): Quick policy update: we've added a pay transparency clause to the handbook. Managers must acknowledge the update and complete a 15-min "Pay Banding & Fairness" microtraining by Mon 06/01. Full text + examples: https://redwood.hr/handbook/pay-transparency. Please confirm via the manager ack form by the deadline.

Aiden (Eng Manager): Is this just disclosure language or are we changing comp bands?

Noah (Compensation): It's disclosure + guidance. Bands remain the same for now. The update clarifies what managers can share (range floor/ceiling, role level) and how to handle candidate/employee requests. We're publishing a companion FAQ with sample scripts.

clara (Recruiter): For active offers in flight, should recruiters include the new disclosure language immediately?

Noah (Compensation): Yes. Effective immediately for external offers. Use the canned paragraph in the FAQ. If you need localized wording for EU offers, ping me and I'll provide wording.

Iris (People Ops): Manager ack form auto-attaches to your manager dashboard. If you manage multiple teams, submit once per manager account. We'll collect acknowledgements and run a compliance report after the deadline.

ops-bot: Export prepared: managers-list-pay-2485012345.csv -> s3://redwood-ops/exports/2026/06/.

Zoe (HR Ops): Uploading a CSV template for bulk ack: email,manager_id,team_count,ack_submitted,notes. Drop your filled CSV here and we'll ingest.

Aiden (Eng Manager): What if I need to discuss a borderline case (compensation tied to signing bonus)? Office hours?

Iris (People Ops): Office hours Thu 2pm PT: https://meet.redwood.com/people-ops/pay-transparency-dropin (recorded). For exceptions around bonus or equity, route to Noah + HR Ops; note the file number in the ack form.

clara (Recruiter): Do ICs need to complete the microtraining or just managers?

Iris (People Ops): Only managers must complete the training and submit the ack. ICs can view the FAQ and optional Q&A.

Noah (Compensation): We'll also run a short calibration workshop next week for managers who signed up (invites sent). If you want to volunteer as a mock interviewer for role-play, RSVP in the invite.

Aiden (Eng Manager): Submitted ack for my teams. Confirmation: ACK-2026-5551. Left a note about one open offer that needs EU language.

Zoe (HR Ops): Received ACK-2026-5551. Please attach the offer ID to the note. We'll follow up on EU wording.

Iris (People Ops): Thanks all. Reminder: deadline Mon 06/01. Non-acknowledgement will trigger automated nudges and a small hold on new req approvals until completed.
thread_text_preview: Iris: pay transparency clause added. Managers must ack + finish 15-min training by Mon 06/01. Export/CSV/office hours and exceptions process posted.
